items.title: Lou Marini interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 15, 2023
items.q: when Belushi introduced me he was on stage by the speakers... I get introduced with James and the “Blue Lous”

ctx.x: Boy, I guess so, with a capital C. Okay last question. Did your son, when did your son learn what a gig was?

Oh well he was around musicians right from the get-go so yeah, he knew what I gig was. I remember though when he was about, he must have been eleven or so, the first Blues Brothers tour, the first gig was at Pine Knob and there were like 20,000 people there. And when Belushi introduced me he was on stage by the speakers and they all started going “Blue Lou! Blue Lou!” and he thought they were booing me. And I remember looking over at him and he had this stricken look on his face, and then realized that no, that…
Awesome. This has been a most marvelous conversation.
